        "All 996 owned diff lines and every changed test/fixture hunk were read. The patch makes show async, waits for a held load promise before base positioning, creates that promise in the loader, and resolves after successful data/description/reload work. Existing tests now await show; the shared opener additionally waits for the open attribute.",
        "The owned missing-ID path clears data and resolves the promise when no reload replaces it. Missing calendar, missing event and non-event paths instead call inherited close and return without resolving that held promise. A rejected calendar.getItem also has no settling handler in this loader. These are bounded static error-path gaps, not an observed hang.",
        "Accepted source has a later connected setup before debounced attribute loading, an explicit missing-ID rejection, close/reset promise replacement and no successful-tail promise=null assignment. The initial-loading contract must be described with these phases separate. Creating the promise during connection resolves the potential first-show timing question in current source.",

        "PositionedDialog.show performs synchronous dimension/position updates after it opens invisibly. The new large-description fixture calls await dialog.show({target}), then checkTolerance with its own document; the helper's four actual Assert.ok calls receive nonempty derived messages. The caller's shold spelling lacks should, but that alone is not a patch defect.",

The retained review contains creation-to-final history, all 16 actual inline bodies, the revealed mutation-observer comment and seven submitted replacement blocks. No summary or test-plan edit exists.",
        "The reported symptom is low positioning after asynchronous description loading near the container bottom. The author distinguishes the per-load internal flag from a promise for queued loading and showing. Actual source is narrower: the internal resolver runs when successful data/reload/description work completes, and async show then invokes base positioning. Resolving that internal promise does not itself prove that the dialog is already shown or that every error path settles.",
        "Review asks for async-purpose JSDoc, the Event type, removal of obsolete test show calls, accurate waits and localDocument documentation. The owned diff adds the show explanation and Event type, removes those unneeded show calls, documents localDocument, and adds the shared helper's open-attribute wait. That wait is made after readyPromise; the reviewer's suggestion to register it before opening is not inferred as adopted. Harness initial-state behavior was not inspected here, so no lost-event failure is claimed.",
        "The close-event proposal is not the final implementation: positionTest calls close and waits for BrowserTestUtils.isHidden. The wait's message says close and reset, but the predicate checks hidden state only. This does not independently establish completion of all asynchronous reset work. The reviewer explicitly describes the later test suggestions as untested.",

Accepted close replaces its promise field, which does not settle a promise already captured by show. The current connected setup separately prepares the initial promise and the missing-ID path rejects. No hang, rejection or positioning failure was reproduced.",
